description: This file implements a real-time transcription provider for OpenAI, including configuration normalization, WebSocket connection management, event handling, and session lifecycle control.

classes.name: OpenAIRealtimeTranscriptionSession
classes.description: Manages a WebSocket connection to OpenAI's real-time transcription API, handles reconnection logic, and processes transcription events.

methods.name: normalizeProviderConfig
methods.description: Normalizes and extracts OpenAI provider configuration from a generic transcription provider config.

methods.name: readProviderConfig
methods.description: Reads and normalizes provider configuration, returning OpenAI-specific settings.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a WebSocket connection to OpenAI's real-time transcription API.

methods.name: sendAudio
methods.description: Sends audio data as a base64-encoded string over the WebSocket.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the WebSocket connection and terminates the session.

methods.name: isConnected
methods.description: Returns whether the WebSocket connection is active.

methods.name: doConnect
methods.description: Handles the WebSocket connection setup, including event handlers and initial session configuration.

methods.name: attemptReconnect
methods.description: Retries WebSocket connection with exponential backoff upon disconnection.

methods.name: handleEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming transcription events and updates the transcript or triggers callbacks.

methods.name: sendEvent
methods.description: Sends an event object over the WebSocket connection.
